page.layout: One scanned page showing the outside of a book: a vellum-covered binding with a leather tie and visible sewing thread along the fore-edge. No printed text is visible on this image.
page.notes: The scan shows the bound cover (limp vellum or parchment wrapper), not a printed page. The cover is blank apart from staining, wrinkling, red speckles and the tie and sewing. No printed words, running heads, page numbers, catchwords or signatures can be read, so nothing is transcribed. The small marks are stains and handling damage, not print.
